thread:
Alex: FYI customer INC-5823 reporting a sharp spike of 5xx on /v1/embeddings for a few hours. They see ~40% failures on batched requests (batch_size=128). Logs -> https://internal-logs/redwood/INC-5823 : some 503s and 504s and a lot of backend queue growth.
Ryan: Can you paste repro steps and whether they're using SDK or direct HTTP? Any recent changes on customer side?
Alex: Using our JS SDK v1.6.2. Repro steps customer gave:
```
for i in {1..200}; do
  curl -s -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings" \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -d '{"model":"embed-base-2","input":["..."],"batch_size":128}' &
done
```
Responses: intermittent `503 Service Unavailable` or `504 Gateway Timeout`. Timestamps in logs aligned with our rolling change this morning.
Monica: we rolled a runtime change earlier to reduce per-tenant KV cache TTL (PR #5123) to force fresher embeddings for a small canary set. TTL was set to `0` for canary to test eviction behavior. If cache misses spike for large-batch embedding workloads this could cause backend amplification and queue pressure.
Yash: also note: SDK PR #5180 changed retry semantics for embedding calls — we now retry 5xx up to 3x with no exponential jitter by default. That combination could create retry storms.
SupportBot: Alert: embedding-service 5xx rate increased by 8x between 4338123000 and 4338123400. Threshold breached. (alert-id: a-emb-778)
Alex: Mitigation actions taken:
- Scoped rate-limit 20 rps to tenant `acme-corp` via admin console (temp). :lock:
- Rolled back TTL=0 on canary nodes to previous value (`ttl=3600`) and started canary redeploy rollback.
- Notified customer: "we've applied a temporary rate limit while we investigate; next update in 30m".
Ryan: I repro'd locally by running a concurrent script hitting embed-base-2 with batch_size=128 and 400 parallel clients. Observed sustained queue depth growth in the embedding-workers and increased `accept_loop` latencies then 503s. Minimal OOMs, but thread pool saturation and connection timeouts.
```
# repro script (abridged)
seq 1 500 | xargs -P 400 -I{} curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -d '{"model":"embed-base-2","input":["x..."],"batch_size":128}'
```
Monica: TODOs:
- grab per-worker queue length / in-flight batch histogram across canary and prod
- check KV cache miss rate around 4338123000
- correlate SDK retries count per request id
Ryan: I captured traces for a few request ids: trace links -> https://trace.redwood/trace/0a1b2c . Looks like many requests started queueing, then the downstream embed worker returned 502/504 upstream after 10s.
CustomerSuccess_Tess: Customer replied they're seeing timeouts in their app and asked for ETA. I told them we have a mitigation and will follow up in 30m with root cause.
Yash: Proposed short-term fixes:
- revert SDK change to add exponential backoff and jitter (release hotfix v1.6.3)
- revert TTL canary (already in progress)
- add tenant-level circuit-breaker for repeated 5xx to avoid retry pileups
Alex: Status update: rate-limit and TTL rollback applied. Error rate partially reduced but still elevated for a subset of requests. We'll continue to gather metrics; next update in 20m. Creating postmortem ticket: PM-embed-5823.
SupportBot: Ticket INC-5823 updated. Customer notified. :white_check_mark:
Monica: After TTL rollback we saw cache hit rate improve on canary and queue depth drop ~50% within 5m. Looks like a strong signal that eviction storm + SDK retries caused amplification. Need follow-up: add guardrails around TTL=0 in runtime and default backoff in SDK.
Alex: I'll draft the customer follow-up email and schedule a follow-up call. Assigning action items in INC-5823: @Monica collect metrics, @Ryan produce repro script & traces, @Yash prepare SDK patch.
Ryan: I'll also run a controlled load test on staging with the SDK patch applied to validate behavior before hotfix.
Alex: Thanks all. Will post final RCA once we have full metric set. :pray:
